sets.title: Concrete urban canal
sets.credit: “Concrete Currents; The Tamed Stream” by Jemir Shamir, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

anomalies.evidence: downstream photo, channel bed: small pieces of plastic litter and debris scattered on the concrete floor and in the water

scene.note: Fully canalized concrete channel with shallow water flowing.

findings.question: channel_form
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center: wide, flat concrete bed between sloping banks

findings.question: bottom_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center: smooth concrete floor visible beneath the shallow water

findings.question: bank_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left and right banks: sloping concrete walls

findings.question: habitats
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right side of channel: patch of green plants growing directly in the water

findings.question: natural_debris
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel bed: no fallen trees, branches, or leaf packs visible

findings.question: water_flow
findings.evidence: downstream photo, center: shallow water moving smoothly across the concrete floor

findings.question: water_aspect
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel bed: the concrete floor is clearly visible through the water

findings.question: water_withdrawal
findings.evidence: downstream photo, whole channel: no intake pipes, pumps, or diversion channels visible

findings.question: barriers
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left side: artificial concrete drop/weir step across the inflowing section

findings.question: draining_pipes
findings.evidence: downstream photo, banks: no draining pipes discharging polluted effluent visible

findings.question: sewage_discharge
findings.evidence: downstream photo, water: no sewage plumes, solids, or greywater discharge visible

findings.question: construction
findings.evidence: downstream photo, channel: no active construction machinery, sandbags, or fresh work visible

findings.question: impervious_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: bank is concrete and top has structures, but ground is mostly open unpaved earth

findings.question: impervious_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, upper right: area beyond the top of the right bank is cut off by the frame

findings.question: vegetation_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: trees and grass patches visible along the banktop

findings.question: vegetation_type_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: mature trees dominate the banktop area

findings.question: vegetation_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: the bank top itself is not visible in the frame

findings.question: vegetation_type_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: no vegetation present on the banktop margin

findings.question: vegetation_cut
findings.evidence: downstream photo, banks: no freshly cut vegetation, mown grass, or cut stumps visible
